# Pari (outreachdev.dev)

> Exclusive lead generation, websites and local marketing for contractors and home-service businesses that do high-end work. Run by Lee Thompson from Clear Lake, Iowa. Serves Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska and the Midwest; remote-friendly nationwide.

Pari works with one contractor per trade, per market. Leads are never shared or resold. Clients own their website, domain, Google Business Profile and data. No long-term contracts.

## Pages
- [Home](https://outreachdev.dev/): what Pari does and how it is different from lead marketplaces
- [Services](https://outreachdev.dev/services/): exclusive lead generation, websites and local SEO, marketing and social, ongoing partnership
- [Who we serve](https://outreachdev.dev/industries/): custom home builders, remodelers, roofing and exteriors, HVAC/plumbing/electrical, landscape/concrete/outdoor
- [About](https://outreachdev.dev/about/): Lee Thompson, background, how the work is done
- [FAQ](https://outreachdev.dev/faq/): pricing approach, exclusivity, contracts, how leads are delivered
- [Contact](https://outreachdev.dev/contact/): book a call, phone 641-596-0111, hello@outreachdev.dev
